paragraph: [In June 2025 Mediabox said it had commissioned an electronic records system, an EDRMS, at Burundi's land titles directorate, the DTFCN](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/burundi-mediabox-deploie-un-systeme-interconnecte-pour-les-services-fonciers>). [The EDRMS is interconnected with the Building Permit System, which handles first titles](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/burundi-mediabox-deploie-un-systeme-interconnecte-pour-les-services-fonciers>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the land system joins records to survey maps or valuation. Operating would need the system to join land records with the cadastre's survey maps or with property valuation.

[La Nation reported the platform in service from 1 January 2025](<https://lanation.bj/actualites/reforme-du-e-foncier-au-benin-plus-de-491-000-parcelles-enregistrees-dans-12-communes>), with mairies, notaries and surveyors. [MDF, which built e-Foncier Bénin with the land agency, says it maps plot boundaries and links them to legal records](<https://www.mdf.nl/assignments/modernising-land-administration-in-benin>). In the last twelve months, [The land agency said in November 2026](<https://fraternite.bj/terra-benin-et-ppmec-ii-pour-accelerer-la-securisation-fonciere/>) that it held 643,993 parcels in 12 communes. No source found since October 2023 says land or property tax is assessed or paid through the land system. Mature would need land or property tax, stamp duty or rates assessed or paid through, or from, the land system.

[The Prime Minister launched SYC@D, Burkina Faso's land and cadastre system, on 21 March 2025](<https://www.minute.bf/gestion-du-foncier-le-burkina-se-dote-du-sycd-pour-digitaliser-lacces-aux-titres-de-propriete/>). [The tax director general said at the launch that the cadastral and geographic databases had been integrated into SYC@D](<https://www.minute.bf/gestion-du-foncier-le-burkina-se-dote-du-sycd-pour-digitaliser-lacces-aux-titres-de-propriete/>). [In May 2025 the land project's coordinator said a national land information system was being developed and deployed](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article138383=>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says land or property tax is assessed or paid through SYC@D. Mature would need land or property tax, stamp duty or rates assessed or paid through, or from, the land system.

In the last twelve months, [The Assistant Minister of Lands told Parliament on 18 August 2026 that Land Board officers across the country can process Secure Land Title transactions electronically](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/92827>). [In November 2025 a minister had said conveyancing, title registration and land transactions were still done by hand](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/89144>). [The 2026/27 budget begins a four-year upgrade of the Land Information System](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/89882>). No source found since October 2023 says the land system joins records to survey maps or valuation. Operating would need the system to join land records with the cadastre's survey maps or with property valuation.

In the last twelve months, [On 12 March 2026 a land committee in Bongouanou validated five rural land certificates](<https://afor.ci/news/nos-actualites/105>). [It used digital maps and geospatial data, and the certificates were signed electronically](<https://afor.ci/news/nos-actualites/105>). [In January 2025 a World Bank mission found AFOR's DIGIFOR and SCCARTO applications working](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099021325040027199/pdf/P179338-ea58f66e-1b11-40a4-a9ed-c2be7b9f4434.pdf>), and [an ordinance making SIFOR the single digital rural land register was still pending](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099021325040027199/pdf/P179338-ea58f66e-1b11-40a4-a9ed-c2be7b9f4434.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says the land system joins records to survey maps or valuation. Operating would need the system to join land records with the cadastre's survey maps or with property valuation.

[The housing ministry was selecting firms on 2 June 2026 to design, supply and install a land information system in Yaoundé and Douala](<https://www.armp.cm/details?id_publication=6404&type_publication=AMI>). [A further call of 11 September 2026 seeks a firm to supervise the provider](<https://armp.cm/details?id_publication=6610&type_publication=AMI>). In the last twelve months, both steps found are calls for firms. No source found says land transactions are processed in a system in service. Establishing would need transfers, registrations or mortgages processed in a land information system in service, in some areas at least.

[Afrique-sur7 reports that the DRC relaunched e-Foncier, its cadastre digitisation project, with the Dubai firm Oxinus](<https://www.afrique-sur7.fr/rdc-projet-de-numerisation-du-foncier-relance>). [A workshop on 26 February 2026 evaluated the pilots of the land information system](<https://fonaredd-rdc.org/rdc-restitution-des-etudes-sur-levaluation-des-initiatives-de-numerisation-du-systeme-dinformation-fonciere-et-de-la-mise-en-place-de-latlas-des-circonscriptions-foncieres/>). [On 28 August 2026 the land minister told the Council of Ministers](<https://beto.cd/cadastre-numerisation-archives-foncieres-rntfi/>) that 250 staff had sorted 16,622 paper land files in 17 Kinshasa districts. The workshop and the minister's report are from the last twelve months. No source found says land transactions are processed in a system in service. Establishing would need transfers, registrations or mortgages processed in a land information system in service, in some areas at least.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether land transactions are processed electronically. Only a 2014 report on the cadastre project has been found, from before the three years searched. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying that land transactions, valuation and planning are run on paper.

[The head of the Comoros Cartography Unit said in April 2026 that a land information system is being set up](<https://fr.linkedin.com/posts/nair-aboubacar-2265a092_un-moment-historique-pour-les-comores-au-activity-7449676142535692288-noIc>). He called it a national priority. The World Bank finances it through a regional climate resilience project, and the unit is building it. That statement is from the last twelve months, and no later step has been found. No source found says land transactions are processed in a system in service. Establishing would need transfers, registrations or mortgages processed in a land information system in service, in some areas at least.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether land transactions are processed electronically. Only 2022 terms of reference describing LMITS have been found, from before the three years searched. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying that land transactions, valuation and planning are run on paper.

[Algeria's finance minister told the National People's Assembly on 12 December 2024](<https://elwatan.dz/conservations-foncieres-instructions-pour-la-creation-dun-guichet-unique/>) that the land conservation offices manage all land transactions digitally. In the last twelve months, [On 11 January 2026 the national domain directorate generalised the Amlak information system](<https://algeriezoom.com/algerie-vers-le-livret-foncier-electronique-avec-amlak/>). It now runs in every cadastre, land conservation and state property office. [Algérie Zoom reports that Amlak is one national system joining the cadastre, land conservation and state property](<https://algeriezoom.com/algerie-vers-le-livret-foncier-electronique-avec-amlak/>). No source found says land or property tax is assessed or paid through Amlak. Mature would need land or property tax, stamp duty or rates assessed or paid through, or from, the land system.

[In July 2025 Egypt's prime minister opened the Real Estate Registry and Notarization Complex in New Alamein, Ahram Online reported](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/2/549747/Egypt/Society/Egypt-PM-inaugurates-Real-Estate-Registry-and-Nota.aspx>). [Sixteen registry offices in the new cities register land, building and unit transactions with electronic tools](<https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/2/549747/Egypt/Society/Egypt-PM-inaugurates-Real-Estate-Registry-and-Nota.aspx>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the land system joins records to survey maps or valuation. Operating would need the system to join land records with the cadastre's survey maps or with property valuation.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether land transactions are processed electronically. Only statements of 2018 and 2019 on the cadastral database have been found, from before the three years searched. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying that land transactions, valuation and planning are run on paper.

[The eLand platform's site says citizens apply online for ownership transfer, lease registration and mortgage registration](<https://land.et>). It names Bishoftu, Adama and Shagar in Oromia as the cities using it. [Finland's foreign ministry says more than 5 million land transactions had been recorded in the digital rural land registry by June 2026](<https://um.fi/results-of-development-cooperation/-/asset_publisher/o2A1dCQquJyC/content/miljoonille-etiopialaisille-oikeus-omaan-maahan/35732>). [The eLand site says it calculates land taxes](<https://land.et>). In the last twelve months, the Finnish figure of June 2026 was reported. Only three Oromia cities are named as using eLand, and its own site is the only source on maps and tax.

[The Lands Commission's Executive Secretary said in October 2026 that ELIS runs in Greater Accra and nine other regions](<https://gna.org.gh/2026/10/lands-commissions-digital-reform-gamechanger-for-land-administration-in-ghana/>). [In July 2026 the Lands Minister said the commission's major services were processed digitally in nine regional offices](<https://www.graphic.com.gh/news/general-news/lands-commission-targets-one-month-land-registration.html>). Both statements are from the last twelve months. [In September 2025 President Mahama told the commission to integrate its Registries, Valuation and Survey departments](<https://gna.org.gh/2025/09/mahama-directs-lands-commission-to-undertake-audit-of-state-lands-allocated-from-2017-2024/>). No source found since October 2023 says ELIS joins records to survey maps or valuation. Operating would need the system to join land records with the cadastre's survey maps or with property valuation.

[On 6 October 2025 the government launched mapping of State agricultural land in Boké, Conakry, Kankan and Kindia, Agronews Guinée reported](<https://www.agronewsguinee.net/2025/10/reforme-fonciere-lancement-de-la-cartographie-des-terres-agricoles-en-guinee/>). [The data are to be centralised in a national database](<https://www.agronewsguinee.net/2025/10/reforme-fonciere-lancement-de-la-cartographie-des-terres-agricoles-en-guinee/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says land transactions are processed in a system in service, and the e-Foncier rural platform is not yet built. Establishing would need transfers, registrations or mortgages processed in a land information system in service, in some areas at least.

[The Land Policy Implementation Unit said on 9 November 2026 that the alpha version of the National Land Information System is complete](<https://senigambia.com/ministry-updates-public-on-national-land-policy-implementation/>). It is in testing before full rollout. [The Ministry of Lands said in September 2026 that a contracted firm is building a digital land registry](<https://standard.gm/lands-policy-implementation-committee-inaugurated>), due in 2027. [Nine firms bid for the system's tender](<https://gambiana.com/land-reforms-gather-pace-as-government-weighs-new-agency-and-sweeping-changes/>), Minister Hamat Bah said in January 2026. All three statements are from the last twelve months. No source found says land transactions are processed in a system in service. Establishing would need transfers, registrations or mortgages processed in a land information system in service, in some areas at least.

[Kenyans.co.ke reports that Ardhisasa processes land searches, transfers and title and lease registration](<https://www.kenyans.co.ke/news/127225-ardhisasa-goes-down-again-users-warned-disrupted-land-services>). [PS Nixon Korir told Parliament in August 2026 that it runs in Nairobi, Murang'a, Mombasa Island and Isiolo](<https://radiogeneration.co.ke/why-ardhisasa-expansion-has-fallen-behind-ps-korir_43436>). Machakos, Kajiado and Baringo were being digitised. [The State Department says stamp duty is assessed and paid through the Module within Ardhisasa, via Ardhipay](<https://lands.go.ke/state-department-lands-rolls-out-nsdm-countrywide-making-land-transactions-faster-and-transparent>). In the last twelve months, [The Law Society says searches, transfers and registrations stopped when Ardhisasa went down in September 2026](<https://eastleighvoice.co.ke/news/396368/lsk-demands-urgent-restoration-of-ardhisasa-platform-amid-land-transaction-delays>). Ardhisasa is still being rolled out section by section, so not every county's transactions are on it.

[The Liberia Land Authority signed a three-year agreement on 16 October 2025 to develop the Liberia Land Information System](<https://analystliberiaonline.com/lla-deepens-land-reforms-launches-new-deed-form-guidelines-digital-system/>). [The Swedish-funded project's manager said in June 2026 that it had introduced a Digital Land Administration System at the Authority](<https://liberianinvestigator.com/swedish-funded-land-reform-project-strengthens-liberia-land-governance/>). [The Authority's chairman listed making the older Land Administration System operational among the project's results](<https://analystliberiaonline.com/lla-deepens-land-reforms-launches-new-deed-form-guidelines-digital-system/>). The June 2026 statement is from the last twelve months. No source found says deeds or transfers are registered in the Land Administration System. Establishing would need transfers, registrations or mortgages processed in a land information system in service, in some areas at least.

[In April 2025 the Real Estate Registration Authority issued its first electronic real estate certificate, LANA reported](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=331206&lang=ar>). [The certificate carries an encrypted QR code and was issued at the South Tripoli registration office](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=331206&lang=ar>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says land transactions are processed in a system in service. Establishing would need transfers, registrations or mortgages processed in a land information system in service, in some areas at least.

No stage is set. The one fact since October 2023 covers Community Council allocation records, which were still kept on paper in 2025. Nothing since then says how the Land Administration Authority processes leases. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying that land transactions, valuation and planning are run on paper.

[Morocco's land agency, ANCFCC, says in its key figures for 2026 that 76% of notarial deed filings with it are made online](<https://www.ancfcc.gov.ma/chiffrecles/>). [In 2013 its e-Foncier service offered online registrations, certificates and titles](<https://www.itu.int/net4/wsis/archive/stocktaking/Project/Details?projectId=1270127883>). [In 2013 e-Foncier was also built on SICAD, which holds the cadastral registers](<https://www.itu.int/net4/wsis/archive/stocktaking/Project/Details?projectId=1270127883>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing since 2023 says how deed filings meet the cadastral maps or valuation. Operating would need the system to join land records with the cadastre's survey maps or with property valuation.

[The land ministry said in April 2025 that the system would be deployed in stages in five pilot regions](<https://newsmada.com/2025/04/17/mdat-deploiement-progressif-du-systeme-dinformation-fonciere/>). [The land services director general said in September 2025 that a national system would be operational soon](<https://newsmada.com/2025/09/13/reformes-foncieres-vers-un-systeme-transparent-et-inclusif/>). In the last twelve months, [Newsmada reports that the GIZ ProPFR project piloted a land information system linking topographic and land offices](<https://newsmada.com/2026/01/05/propfr-giz-dix-ans-pour-instaurer-une-politique-fonciere-responsable/>). No source found says land transactions are processed in a system in service. Establishing would need transfers, registrations or mortgages processed in a land information system in service, in some areas at least.

[A 2026 study of land conflict around Bamako describes NINACAD, a programme of SPRDF, Mali's land reform secretariat](<https://horizon.documentation.ird.fr/exl-doc/pleins_textes/2026-04/010096542.pdf>). [In January 2023 SPRDF claimed 648,057 parcels online](<https://horizon.documentation.ird.fr/exl-doc/pleins_textes/2026-04/010096542.pdf>). [NINACAD is a national cadastral identifier given to parcels](<https://horizon.documentation.ird.fr/exl-doc/pleins_textes/2026-04/010096542.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says land transactions are processed in a system in service. Establishing would need transfers, registrations or mortgages processed in a land information system in service, in some areas at least.

[A 2021 paper said SiGIT, Mozambique's land information system, had recorded 1,375,586 parcels by March 2020](<https://www.mdpi.com/2073-445X/10/8/818>). [The MCC's 2024 evaluation brief says use of the system has largely not been sustained](<https://www.mcc.gov/resources/doc/evalbrief-052824-moz-land-tenure-regularization/>). In many land offices it does not work or serves only as a back-up database, and those offices still rely on paper records. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a land information or land administration system procured, piloted in some regions or being built.

[In April 2024 Mauritania's Administration Générale des Domaines said it had begun registering all contracts through the Lagoud platform](<https://fr.madar.mr/actualites/mauritanie-procedures-pour-faciliter-lenregistrement-des-contrats-a-travers-une-plateforme-numerique/>). [Final copies of registered contracts are put online](<https://fr.madar.mr/actualites/mauritanie-procedures-pour-faciliter-lenregistrement-des-contrats-a-travers-une-plateforme-numerique/>). On fees, [since April 2024 registration fees have been paid by mobile apps](<https://fr.madar.mr/actualites/mauritanie-procedures-pour-faciliter-lenregistrement-des-contrats-a-travers-une-plateforme-numerique/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the land system joins records to survey maps or valuation. Operating would need the system to join land records with the cadastre's survey maps or with property valuation.

[The Registrar-General's Department registers deeds of sale, mortgages and discharges, and leases online](<http://registrar.govmu.org/rgd/index.php/faqs/>), under guidance dated 2026. [Registration duty is paid online through MeRS](<http://registrar.govmu.org/rgd/index.php/faqs/>). [LAVIMS joined a digital cadastral database, a valuation of all residential and commercial sites and deeds registration by parcel](<https://housing.govmu.org/Pages/Dept%20and%20Org/Divisions/Survey/The-Cadastre-Unit.aspx>), as the ministry has described it since 2012. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing since 2023 says MeRS records are joined to the cadastre or to valuation. Operating would need the system to join land records with the cadastre's survey maps or with property valuation.

[ITWeb Africa reports that Malawi launched its web-based Land Information Management System in February 2024](<https://itweb.africa/article/malawi-reviews-digital-land-workflows/rW1xLv5ngAp7Rk6m>). [About 130,000 customary parcels had been registered in it by July 2026](<https://www.ednews.africa/p/new-hope-for-malawis-farmers-as-agcom>). [The Lands Minister said in October 2026 that lease approvals are now digital](<https://www.247malawi.com/one-year-of-dpp-how-chipungu-is-securing-land-for-every-malawian-exclusive-interview/>). The July and October 2026 statements are from the last twelve months. Some transactions remain manual, and nothing says the system joins records to survey maps or valuation. Operating would need the system to join land records with the cadastre's survey maps or with property valuation.

[NCLAS 1 was rolled out to all Communal Land Boards in 2008](<https://www.fig.net/resources/proceedings/fig_proceedings/fig2024/ppt/ts02g/TS02G_mazambani_12660_ppt.pdf>). [The ministry introduced web-based NCLAS 2 in 2014](<https://www.fig.net/resources/proceedings/fig_proceedings/fig2024/ppt/ts02g/TS02G_mazambani_12660_ppt.pdf>). [The presentation says NCLAS has two components, communal deeds and communal cadastre (parcel geometries)](<https://www.fig.net/resources/proceedings/fig_proceedings/fig2024/ppt/ts02g/TS02G_mazambani_12660_ppt.pdf>), linked via a Unique Parcel Identifier. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says land or property tax is assessed or paid through the land system. Mature would need land or property tax, stamp duty or rates assessed or paid through, or from, the land system.

[The minister of urbanism and housing said a single cadastre is being delivered through the E-Cadastre project](<https://www.lesahel.org/entretien-avec-le-ministre-de-lurbanisme-et-de-lhabitat-le-colonel-major-abdoulkadri-amadou-dresse-le-bilan-des-reformes-et-des-chantiers-en-cours/>). The project is developed with ANSI and financed by the World Bank PVI, and cadastral digitalisation is a priority. The minister spoke in June 2026, within the last twelve months. [The Minister of Urbanism and Habitat chaired a meeting on the E-Cadastre project, run with ANSI](<https://nouvelledafrique.tg/e-cadastre-le-niger-digitalise-son-foncier-pour-plus-de-transparence-et-defficacite/>). No source found says land transactions are processed in a system in service. Establishing would need transfers, registrations or mortgages processed in a land information system in service, in some areas at least.

[Kwara State launched its KW-GIS land information system](<https://von.gov.ng/kwara-government-launches-digital-land-administration-process/>), where investors and titleholders register land and process certificates of occupancy online. [Lagos moved land title applications from paper to its e-GIS portal in January 2024](<https://businessday.ng/life/article/lagos-revolutionises-land-acquisition-as-sanwo-olu-launches-automated-application-portal/>). [The Kwara revenue service says its payment platform is integrated with the land system](<https://von.gov.ng/kwara-government-launches-digital-land-administration-process/>). In the last twelve months, [Cross River State's 360Lands registry has issued 188 certificates of occupancy](<https://guardian.ng/technology/tech-firm-to-tackle-delays-in-c-of-o-processing/>), its developer said in June 2026. Only Kwara State's system is shown linked to tax, and nothing says the federal repository is in service.

[In February 2026 Environment Minister Bernadette Arakwiye said Rwanda's Land Administration Information System (LAIS) holds all land and owner data](<https://ickjournalism.com/impamvu-u-rwanda-rukeneye-abakozi-3000-bo-gutanga-serivisi-zubutaka/>). [She said it handles land registration, boundary correction and transfers](<https://ickjournalism.com/impamvu-u-rwanda-rukeneye-abakozi-3000-bo-gutanga-serivisi-zubutaka/>). [In January 2026 the National Land Authority said LAIS is a national registry with a spatial database](<https://www.un.org/globalgeospatial/sites/default/files/2026-04/rwanda_land_administration_case_study_unggkic.pdf>). Both statements were made in the last twelve months. [In February 2026 Minister Arakwiye said LAIS is connected to the tax payment system](<https://ickjournalism.com/impamvu-u-rwanda-rukeneye-abakozi-3000-bo-gutanga-serivisi-zubutaka/>).

[PROCASEF says it has built 128 land offices fitted with SIFCOM, a communal land information system](<https://procasef.com/financement-additionnel-du-procasef-des-rencontres-dinformation-avec-60-communes-preselectionnees-pour-consolider-la-securisation-fonciere-au-senegal/>). [In December 2025 it said SIFCOM is planned to run in the project's 136 communal land offices](<https://procasef.com/fidak-2025-panel-sur-la-dematerialisation-des-procedures-foncieres-le-procasef-au-coeur-de-la-modernisation-du-foncier-senegalais/>). An electronic land book is to replace the paper registers. The December 2025 statement is from the last twelve months. No source found says land transactions are processed in SIFCOM. Establishing would need transfers, registrations or mortgages processed in a land information system in service, in some areas at least.

[The World Bank's April 2024 status report says the land administration project would advertise the land information system consultancy that month](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099041024065516011/pdf/P1770311f0362d0d01b4bf1fa651ae664b7.pdf>). [Its October 2024 report says procurement was still open](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102924175012156/pdf/P177031-6773547a-5b87-4c2c-9ac7-3f49fd446856.pdf>), with no transactions yet registered in a system. [The Chief Minister said in April 2025 that the lands ministry expects to launch a land management information system](<https://sierraloaded.sl/news/sengeh-highlights-progress-land-reforms-bio/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says land transactions are processed in a system in service. Establishing would need transfers, registrations or mortgages processed in a land information system in service, in some areas at least.

[FAO sought consultants on 23 September 2025 to develop a Land Information System for South Sudan](<https://www.ungm.org/Public/Notice/279257>). Bids closed on 30 October 2025. [Central Equatoria State launched a Digital Land Registry for Juba on 11 August 2023](<https://www.eyeradio.org/ces-introduces-digital-land-registry-system/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing since October 2023 says land transactions are processed in a system in service. Establishing would need transfers, registrations or mortgages processed in a land information system in service, in some areas at least.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether land transactions are processed electronically. Only a 2020 registry digitisation project and a 2022 account of the paper registry have been found, from before the three years searched. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying that land transactions, valuation and planning are run on paper.

[The Ministry of Natural Resources and Energy says the Deeds Registry has computerised its land, debts and miscellaneous contract registers since 1995](<https://gov.sz/index.php/departments-sp-623334762/deeds>). The registers are updated daily as ownership changes hands. [Kenya's State Department for Lands reports that Registrar of Deeds Nozipho Vilakati said Eswatini is working to upgrade its manual registration and storage of deeds](<https://web.archive.org/web/20251116190816/https://lands.go.ke/eswatini-delegation-returns-kenya-benchmarking-lands-digitization>). The aim is a fully electronic system. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing since October 2023 says the land system joins records to survey maps or valuation. Operating would need the system to join land records with the cadastre's survey maps or with property valuation.

[On 22 January 2025 the Lands Department invited tenders for an online Land Valuation System](<https://www.ntb.sc/media/tender-files/22.01.2025_Advert_for_LVS_003.pdf>). [It is to interface with SeyID and the National Population Database](<https://www.ntb.sc/media/tender-files/22.01.2025_Advert_for_LVS_003.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says land transactions are processed in a system in service.
